sa: माता च मम कौसल्या कुशलं चाभिवादनम्। अप्रमादं च वक्तव्या ब्रूयाश्चैनामिदं वचः॥ धर्मनित्या यथाकालमग्न्यगारपरा भव। देवि देवस्य पादौ च देववत् परिपालय॥
en: Having saluted my mother Kausalyā and conveyed to her news of my welfare, as well as of my unswerving adherence to morality, do you tell her these words, Do you remaining steady in virtue, at the proper hour bestir yourself in behalf of the chamber of sacrificial fire. And, O revered one, do you minister to the feet of that worshipful one, (the king), as if they were very deities.

sa: अहोरात्राणि गच्छन्ति सर्वेषां प्राणिनामिह। आयूंषि क्षपयन्त्याशु ग्रीष्मे जलमिवांशवः॥
en: In this world, days and nights pass away with creatures, and speedily impair their lives, even as in summer the rays (of the sun) (dry up) the waters.

sa: तं रथस्थं धनुष्पाणिं राक्षसं पर्यवस्थितम्। ददृशुः सर्वभूतानि पाशहस्तमिवान्तकम्॥
en: And as that Rākşasa sat on his car, bow in hand, all creatures saw him, as if he were the very destroyer with the noose in his hand.

sa: यवद्वीपमतिक्रम्य शिशिरो नाम पर्वतः। दिवं स्पृशति शृङ्गेण देवदानवसेवितः॥
en: And, going beyond the island of Yava. (one comes upon) the hill called Sisira, which pierceth the heavens by its peaks, and is inhabited by gods and demons.

sa: तं कामवृत्तं मम संनिकृष्टं कामाभियोगाच्च विमुक्तलज्जम्। स्त्वद्भातरं वानरवंशनाथम्॥
en: Do you forgive that lord of the monkey race, your brother influenced by carnality, who is by you, and who through the urgency of lust, has banished shame.

sa: एतदत्यद्रुतं वृत्तं पुण्ये हि भवति प्रभो। वासुदेवस्य कौन्तेय स्थाणोश्चैव स्वभावजम्॥
en: O powerful king, these are the wonderful incidents which took place on the sacred breast of Himavat about Vasudeva and Sthani, son of Kunti. Those events emanated from the very nature of those great deities.

sa: पिनह्य तानि पुष्पाणि केशेषु वरर्णिनी। आमन्त्रिता ततोऽगच्छद् रुचिरङ्गपतेर्गृहम्॥
en: Ruchi, of great beauty, having attached those flowers to her hair, went to the palace of the king of the Angas to answer the invitation she had received,

sa: आशया संचितं द्रव्यं कालेनैवोपभुज्यते। अन्ये चैतत् प्रपद्यन्ते वियोगे तस्य देहिनः॥
en: If one does not enjoy in good time what he has stored with hope, the result is that the stored wealth passes into another man's hands after the death of him who has stored it.

sa: प्रासादा यत्र सौवर्णा वसोर्धारा च यत्र सा। गन्धर्वाप्सरसो यत्र तत्र यान्ति सहस्रदाः॥
en: They who make gifts of a thousand kine, leaving this world proceed to the regions of the Gandharvas and the celestial nymphs where there are many palatial buildings made of gold and where the celestial Ganga, called the current of Vasu, runs.

sa: न भूमिदानाद् देवेन्द्र परं किंचिदिति प्रभो। विशिष्टमिति मन्यामि यथा प्राहुर्मनीषिणः॥
en: There is no gift, O king of the celestials, higher than the gift of earth, O powerful one. I consider this gift as the most superior, according to what has been declared by the wise.

sa: गोप्रदानरतो याति भित्त्वा जलदसंचयान्। विमानेनार्कचर्णेन दिवि राजन् विराजते।॥
en: That man, O king, who habitually makes gifts of kine, proceeds passing through the clouds, on a sunny car to the celestial region and shines there in splendour.

sa: सवत्सां पीवरी दत्त्वा दृतिकण्ठामलंकृताम्। वैश्वदेवमसम्बाध स्थानं श्रेष्ठं प्रपद्यते॥
en: By giving away a fat cow with the flesh of its throat hanging down and accompanied by her calf, one acquires easily the high region of the Vishvedevas.

sa: धिक् त्वामस्तु सुदुर्बुद्धिं क्षत्रधर्मबहिष्कृतम्। यो मा युद्धाय सम्प्राप्तं साम्नैव प्रत्यगृह्णथाः॥
en: Fie on you, O you of foolish understanding, Fie on you who have deviated from Kshatriya duties! Fie on you who would receive me peacefully even though I have come here for fighting with you.

sa: पाणिग्रहणमन्त्राणां निष्ठा स्यात् सप्तमे पदे। भार्या स्याद् यस्य चाद्भिः प्रदीयते।
en: The Mantras of marriage accomplish their object of bringing about the indissoluble union of marriage at the seventh step. The maiden becomes the wife of him to whom the gift is actually made with water.

sa: लोहितां तुल्यवत्सां तु धेनुं दत्त्वा पयस्विनीम्। सुव्रतां वस्त्रसंवीतां सूर्यलोके महीयते॥
en: By giving away a red cow with a calf that resembes herself, giving milk, free from every vice, and covered with a piece of cloth, one acquires great honours in the region of the Sun.

sa: ततः कदाचिद् भगवानुत्तङ्गस्तोयकांक्षया। तृषितः परिचक्राम मरौ सस्मार चाच्युतम्॥
en: Subsequently, one day, the illustrious Utanka, solicitous of water and greatly thirsty, wandered over the desert. In course of his wanderings he thought of Krishna of unfading glory.

sa: उमोवाच निवासा बहुरूपास्ते दिवि सर्वगुणान्विताः। तांश्च संत्यज्य भगवश्मशाने रमसे कथम्॥
en: Uma said You have many houses, in the celestial region, of various forms and possessed of every comfort and luxury. Why, O Holy One, do you live in the crematorium, abandoning all those delightful palaces.

sa: जानाम्यहमिदं युद्धं त्वया मद्वचनात् कृतम्। स्त्रीणामागमने हेतुमहमिच्छामि वेदितुम्॥
en: I know that you had fought this battle with me at my own command. I wish to know what the cause is which has brought out the ladies.

sa: जगत् सर्वं च निर्मथ्य तेजोराशिः समुत्थितः। सुवर्णमेभ्यो विप्रर्षे रत्नं परममुत्तमम्॥
en: Churning the entire universe, a mass of energy was found. That energy is gold. Hence, O twiceborn Rishi, compared to all these objects gold is surely superior. It is a valuable thing, high and excellent.

sa: गवां मूत्रपुरीषस्य नोद्विजेत कथंचन। न चासां मांसमश्नीयाद् गवां पुष्टिं तथाप्नुयात्॥
en: One should never feel any repugnance for the urine and the dung of the cow. One should never eat the meat of kine. As the result of this, one is sure to acquire great prosperity.

sa: इत्येतदसुरेन्द्राय काव्यः प्रोवाच भार्गवः। सुवर्णाय मनुः प्राह सुवर्णो नारदाय च॥
en: Thus did the learned Kavi oi Bhrigu's race discourse to Bali the chief of the Asuras. That discourse was next recited by Manu to the Rishi Suvarna. Suvarna, in his turn, recited it to Narada.

sa: भीष्म उवाच इत्युक्तो विपुलस्तेन तपस्वी नियतेन्द्रियः॥ सदैवोग्रतपा राजन्नग्न्यर्कसदृशद्युतिः। धर्मज्ञः सत्यवादी च तथेति प्रत्यभाषत। पुनश्चेदं महाराज पप्रच्छ प्रस्थितं गुरुम्॥
en: Bhishma said Thus addressed by his preceptor, the ascetic Vipula, with senses restrained, always engaged in severe penances, possessed of the splendour, O king, of fire or the sun, conversant with all the duties of virtue, and ever truthful in speech, answered him, saying So be it! Once more, however, as his preceptor was about to start, Vipula asked him in these words.

sa: भीष्म उवाच तस्मै प्रोवाच वचनं प्रणताय हितं तदा। गवामुपनिषद्विद्वान् नमस्कृत्य गवां शुचिः॥
en: Bhishma said Having first bowed to kine and purified himself, the learned Vashishtha described to king Saudasa who stood before him with head bent in reverence, the mystery about kine, a subject that is fraught with results highly beneficial to all persons.

sa: सपुत्रः स्यादपुत्रो तत्तु दत्तं हरेत् पित्रा नादत्तं हर्तुमर्हति। अवश्यं हि धनं देयं शूद्रापुत्राय भारत॥
en: That share, however, he is to take only when his father has given it to him. He shall not take it if his father does not give it to him. Some portion of the father's riches should, forsooth, be given O Bharata, to the son of the Shudra wife.

sa: नारद उवाच तपश्चचार धर्मात्मा वृषभाङ्कः सुरेश्वरः। पुण्ये गिरौ हिमवति सिद्धचारणसेविते॥
en: Narada said Once on a time the pious lord of all the celestials, viz., Mahadeva having bull for his emblem, practised severe penances on the sacred mountains of Himavat the resort of Siddhas and Charanas,

sa: जातानां समवर्णायाः पुत्राणामविशेषतः। सर्वेषामेव वर्णानां समभागो धनात् स्मृतः॥
en: As for all the castes, the children born of the wife taken from the husband's own caste shall, it has been laid down, share equally the father's wealth.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रपयित्वा पशूनन्यान् विधिवद् द्विजसत्तमाः। तं तुरङ्गं यथाशास्त्रमालभन्त द्विजातयः॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having cooked, according to due rites, the other excellent animals which were sacrificed, the priests then sacrificed, according to the injunctions of the scriptures, that horse (which had wandered over the whole world).

sa: पृथिव्यामप्रतिहतो वीर्येण च भविष्यति। विक्रमेण च सम्पन्न: सर्वपार्थिवपार्थिवः॥
en: Gifted with great energy, he will be rich with the jewels and gems of all rulers of the Earth. Indeed, in energy he will be peerless on Earth.

sa: अथ तान् द्विरदः कश्चित् सुरेन्द्रद्विरदोपमः॥ अश्वत्थस्थोऽग्निरित्येवमाह देवान् भृगूद्वह।
en: Then, O perpetuator of Bhrigu's race, an elephant, as large and powerful as the elephant of Shakra addressed the gods, sayingAgni is now living within this Ashvattha tree!

sa: द्वो चापि भार्ये द्वयोरात्मास्य जायते। शूद्रा शूद्रस्य यचाप्येका शूद्रमेव प्रजायते॥
en: The Vaishya may take two wives. In both of them, he takes birth himself. The Shudra can take only one wife, from his own caste. The son begotten by him upon her becomes a Shudra.

sa: याश्च शश्वद् बहुमता रक्ष्यन्ते दयिताः स्त्रियः। अपि ताः सम्प्रसज्जन्ते कुब्जान्धजडवामनैः॥
en: Even those women who are loved by their husbands and treated with great respect, are seen to confer their favours upon men who are humpbacked, who are blind, who are idiots or who are dwarfs.

sa: ज्ञातिसम्बन्धिनस्तुष्टाः शौचेन च नृपस्य नः। देवा हविर्भिः पुण्यैश्च रक्षणैः शरणागताः॥
en: Kinsmen and relatives have been pleased by the purity of conduct shown by our king. The celestials have been pleased by libations of clarified butter and acts of merit, and dependents and followers by protection.

sa: अश्वमेधक्रतोस्तुल्यं फलं भवति शाश्वतम्। मृत्युकाले सहस्राक्ष यां वृत्तिमनुकाझते॥
en: The merit such a man wins is equal to the eternal merit of a Horsesacrifice. Such a person acquires whatever end he desires at the hour of death.

sa: यथा श्वा भषितुं चैव हन्तुं चैवावसज्जते। एवं सम्भाषणार्थाय सर्वशास्त्रवधाय च॥
en: As a dog, meets others, barking the while and seeking to bite, such a person is even so, for he spends his breath in vain and tries to destroy the authority of all the scriptures.

sa: मृदमापस्तथान्नानि पत्रपुष्पफलानि च। असंवृतानि गृह्णीयात् प्रवृत्तानि च कार्यवान्॥
en: One should take only earth, water, pebbles, leaves, flowers, and fruits, which are not owned by any body, as they come, when one wishes to do any act.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच श्रुत्वा धर्मानशेषेण पावनानि च सर्वशः। युधिष्ठिरः शान्तनवं पुनरेवाभ्यभाषत॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard all the duties in full and all those sacred deeds and objects which purify human beings of their sins, Yudhishthira once inore addressed the son of Shantanu in the following words.

sa: श्वशुर उवाच वातातपविशीर्णाङ्गी त्वां विवर्णो निरीक्ष्य वै। कर्षितां सुव्रताचारे क्षुधविह्वलचेतसम्॥ कथं सक्तून् ग्रहन्यामि भूत्वा धर्मोपघातकः। कल्याणवृत्ते कल्याणि नैवं त्वं वक्तुमर्हसि॥
en: The Father-in-law said-O you of excellent vows and conduct, seeing you wasted by wind and sun, deprived of your very complexion, emaciated, and almost destitute of consciousness through hunger, how can I be such a transgressor against the rules of virtue as to take your share of the barley? O auspicious damsel, you should not say so, for the sake of those auspicious results for which every family must try.

sa: इत्युक्तास्ते निषादास्तु सुभृशं भयकम्पिताः। सर्वे विवर्णवदना नहुषाय न्यवेदयन्॥
en: When he said these words to them, the fishermen became greatly terrified. With pale faces they went to king Nahusha and informed him of all that had occurred.

sa: शको ह्यज्ञातरूपेण जटी भूत्वा रजोगुणः। विरूपं रथमास्थाय प्रश्न पप्रच्छ शम्बरम्॥
en: Once upon a time Shakra, assuming the guise of an ascetic with matted locks on his head and body covered with ashes all over, rode on an ugly car and went to the Asura Shambara.

sa: आदिकर्ता च लोकस्य तत्परं ब्रह्म तध्रुवम्। सर्वकामदमित्याहुस्तद्रहस्यमुवाच ह॥ ततोऽब्रबीन्महादेवो वरुणः पवनात्मकः। मम सत्रमिदं दिव्यमहं गृहपतिस्त्विह॥ त्रीणि पूर्वाण्यपत्यानि मम तानि न संशयः। इति जानीत खगमा मम यज्ञफलं हि तत्॥
en: The first Creator of the universe declared Agni to be Supreme Brahma and Eternal, and the giver of all desires. This is indeed, a mystery, After all these births had taken place, Mahadeva who had assumed the form of Varuna (for his sacrifice) and who had Pavana for his soul, said, This excellent Sacrifice is minc. I am the Grahapati in it. The three beings that first originated from the sacrificial fire are mine! Forsooth, they should be considered as my children. Know this, you gods who range through the skies! They are the fruits of this Sacrifice.

sa: यः प्रवृत्तां श्रुति सम्यक् शास्त्रं वा मुनिभिः कृतम्। दूषयत्यनभिज्ञाय तं विद्याद् ब्रह्मघातिनम्॥
en: You should take that man as guilty of Brahmanicide who, without studying them, finds fault with the Shrutis that have come down: from preceptor to pupil for ages and ages together, or with those scriptures that have been composed by the Rishis.

sa: ततो जग्राह धर्मे स स्थितिमिन्द्रनिभो नृपः। तथेति चोदितः प्रीतस्तावृषी प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: Like a second, Indra the king of the celestials, he accepted the boon about his own steadiness in virtue. The Rishis having granted him the boon, the delighted king adored them both with great respect.

sa: पापयोनिं समापन्नाश्चण्डाला मूकचूचुकाः। वर्णान् पर्यायशश्चापि प्राप्नुवन्त्युत्तरोत्तरम्॥ शूद्रयोनिमतिक्रम्य ये चान्ये तामसा गुणाः। स्रोतोमध्ये समागम्य वर्तन्ते तामसे गुणे॥
en: Coming to sinful births and becoming Chandalas or human beings that are deaf or to who lisp indistinctly, they attain to higher and higher castes, one after another in proper turn, getting above the Shudra order, and other (consequences of) qualities which belong to Ignorance and who abide in it in course of migrations this world.

sa: ब्राह्मणं जातिसम्पन्नं धर्मज्ञं संशितं शुचिम्। अपरेषां परेषां च परेभ्यश्चैव येऽपरे॥
en: Even this is what Narada said to me, viz., that one should always respect a Brahmana that is well born, of rigid vows, and conversant with the scriptures, if one wishes every kind of prosperity.

sa: नामधेयानि देवेषु वहून्यस्य यथार्थवत्। निरुच्यन्ते महत्त्वाच्च विभुत्वात् कर्मभिस्तथा॥
en: Amongst the gods he has many significant names. Indeed, the meanings of those names are derived from either his greatness or vastness, or his feats, or his conduct.

sa: नूनमर्थवतां मध्ये तव वाक्यमनुत्तमम्। न भाति कालेऽभिहितं तेनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: The words spoken by you, even when excellent in the midst of rich men, are not regarded by them as wise or well timed. It is for this that you are so pale and lean.

sa: यतश्चायं प्रभवति प्रेत्य यत्र च गच्छति। वेदेष मार्ग स्वर्गस्य तथैव नरकस्य च॥
en: The Brahmana is acquainted with that from which this universe has originated and to which, when apparently, destroyed it. returns. Indeed, the Brahmana knows the path that leads to the celestial region and the other path which leads to the opposite place.

sa: व्यासश्च भगवान् नित्यमासांचक्रे नृपेण ह। कथाः कुर्वन् पुराणर्षिर्देवर्षिपितृरक्षसाम्॥
en: The holy Vyasa also used to often meet with the old king and recite to him the histories of old Rishis and celestial ascetics and Pitris and Rakshasas.

sa: ऋषयस्तुष्टुवुश्चैव गन्धर्वाश्च जगुस्तथा। षडाननं कुमारं तु द्विषडक्षं द्विजप्रियम्॥
en: The Rishis sang hymns of praise and the Gandharvas sang in honour of that child called Kumara of six heads, twelve eyes, and greatly devoted to the Brahmanas.

sa: क्रीडत: क्रीडनीयानि ददुः पक्षिगणाश्च ह। सुपर्णोऽस्य ददौ पुत्रं मयूरं चित्रबर्हिणम्॥
en: As he played like a child, various sorts of toys and birds were given to him. Garuda of excellent feathers gave to him a child of his, viz., a peacock having plumes of variegated colour.

sa: कौमारचारी व्रतवान् मैत्रेय निरतो भव। एतद् गृहाण प्रथमं प्रशस्तं गृहमेधिनाम्॥
en: You are possessed of youth, O Maitreya! you are observant of vows. Be devoted to virtuc. Do you take instructions from me about thosc duties which you should first follow, the duties, viz., of householders.

sa: लोको ह्यार्यगुणानेव भूयिष्ठं तु प्रशंसति। रूपमानवयोमानश्रीमानाचाप्यसंशयम्॥
en: Good men highly speak of righteous qualities. By your good luck you are not overwhelmed by personal beauty, youth and prosperity.

sa: दानकृद्भिः कृतः पन्था येन यान्ति मनीषिणः। ते हि प्राणस्य दातारस्तेषु धर्मः प्रतिष्ठितः॥
en: The road that has been made by those men, who make gifts is the road that is trodden by the wise. They who make gifts are considered as givers of even the life-breaths. The duties that forin virtue are established in them.

sa: एवं धूपप्रदानं च दीपदानं च साधवः। प्रयच्छन्ति नमस्कारैर्युक्तमात्मगुणावहम्॥
en: Pious and wise persons make offering of incense and lights, accompanying them with bows and prostrations. Such acts always yield advancement and prosperity to those that do them.

sa: तस्य धूमस्तमो रूपं रजो भस्मसु तेजसः। सर्वं संजायते तस्य यत्र प्रक्षिप्यते हविः॥
en: The smoke of that firc is of the form of Darkness. The quality that is known by the name of Passion is in it ashes. The quality of goodness originate from that portion of the fire into which the oblation is poured.

sa: अगारमद्वारमिव प्रविश्य संकल्पभोगान् विषये निबद्धान्। प्राणक्षये शान्तिमुपैति नित्यं दारुक्षयेऽग्निलितो यथैव॥
en: One entering upon enjoyments depending on purposes alone and unconnected with actual objects of sense, always meets with death upon the exhaustion of the vital airs, like an enkindled fore upon the exhaustion of fuel.

sa: गाथाश्चाप्यत्र गायन्ति पितृगीता युधिष्ठिर। सनत्कुमारो भगवान् पुरा मय्यभ्यभाषत॥
en: Regarding it, O Yudhishthira, there are some Verses, originally sung by the departed Manes, that are now sung (in the world). Sanatkumara communicated them to me former days.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्रैव कीर्त्यते सद्भिाह्मणस्वाभिमर्शने। नृगेण सुमहत् कृच्छ्रे यदवाप्तं कृरूद्वह।॥
en: Bhishma said Regarding it, O perpetuator of Kuru race, is recited by the righteous the narrative of the great calamity that befell king Nriga on account of his taking what had belonged to a Brahmana.

sa: अपि पापसमाचारं ब्रह्मघ्नमपि चानृतम्। सैव पापं प्लावयति सैव पापात् प्रमोचयेत्॥
en: The man who is of sinful conduct who is guilty of Brahmanicide and of falsehood, is purified by a gift of earth. Indeed, such a gift rescues even such a sinner from all his sins.

sa: श्वानश्च पतिदूषाश्च नावेक्षेरन् कथंचन। तस्मात् परिसृते दद्यात् तिलांश्चान्ववकीरयेत्॥
en: Whatever, again is given with malice, and whatever is given without respect, have been ordained by Brahman himself as the portion of the king of Asuras (viz., Bali.)

sa: रत्नदानं च सुमहत् पुण्यमुक्तं जनाधिप। यस्तान् विक्रीय यजते ब्राह्मणो ह्यभयंकरम्॥
en: It has been said, O king, that the gift of gems is a very great gift. The Brahmana, who having accepted a gift of gems, sells the same for celebrating a sacrifice, commits no sin.

sa: सम्यग्युक्तो यदाऽऽत्मानमात्मन्येव प्रपश्यति। तदैव न स्पृहयते साक्षादपि शतक्रतोः॥
en: When one, after adequate devotion to Yoga, sees the Soul in his ownself, he then ceases to have any regard for even him of a hundred sacrifices (India).

sa: अहिंसा परमो धर्मस्तथाऽहिंसा परो दमः। अहिंसा परमं दानमहिंसा परमं तपः॥ अहिंसा परमो यज्ञस्तथाहिंसा परं फलम्। अहिंसा परमं मित्रमहिंसा परमं सुखम्॥
en: Abstention from cruelty is the highest Religion. Abstention from cruelty is the greatest self-restraint. Abstention from cruelty is the highest gift. Abstention from cruelty is the highest penance. Abstention from cruelty is the highest sacrifice. Abstention from cruelty is the highest power. Abstention from cruelty is the greatest friend. Abstention from cruelty is the greatest happiness. Abstention from cruelty is the highest truth. Abstention from cruelty is the highest Shruti.

sa: अपूपान् विविधाकाराशाकानि विविधानि च। खाण्डवान् रसयोगान्न तथेच्छन्ति यथाऽऽमिषम्॥
en: Alas, they do not relish various kinds of cakes and diverse sorts of potherbs and various species of Khanda with juicy flavour so much as they do flesh.

sa: अथ कृत्वोपहार्याणि चतुर्दश्यां महामतिः। तमेव गणयशोकं विरात्रे प्रत्यबुध्यत॥
en: Thanking of that cause of sorrow, the great Nimi collected together various agreeable objects on the fourteenth day of the moon. The next morning he rose from bed.

sa: तमभ्ययात् प्रहर्षेण नरेन्द्रः सह भार्यया। अन्तर्हितस्ततो भूयश्च्यवनः शयनं च तत्॥
en: With his wife by his side, the king approached, with an exulting heart, the Rishi as he lay on that bed. Chyavana, however, speedily disappeared at this, with the bed itself upon which he lay.

sa: अनमित्रश्च निर्बधुरनपत्यश्च यः क्वचित्। त्यक्तधर्मार्थकामश्च निराकाक्षी च मुच्यते॥
en: He is liberated who has no enemy, no। kinsman, and no child, who has cast off religion, riches and pleasure, and who is freed from desire or cupidity.

sa: कृत्वाग्नौ करणं पूर्व मन्त्रपूर्वं तपोधन। ततोऽग्नयेऽथ सोमाय वरुणाय च नित्यशः॥
en: Having first performed the Karna on the sacred fire with the help of Mantras, O you having penances for wealth, one should always pour libations next to the god of fire, and Soma, and Varuna.

sa: तानविब्रुवतः किंचित् सर्वाशोकपरायणान्। पुनरेव महातेजा धृतराष्ट्रोऽव्रीदिदम्॥
en: Desirous of telling those grief stricken people something more, the highly energetic Dhritarashtra once more addressed them and said as follows.

sa: ते श्राद्धनाच॑माना वै विमुच्यन्ते ह किल्बिषात्। सप्तकः पितृवंशस्तु पूर्वदृष्टः स्वयम्भुवा॥
en: By worshipping all those gods at Shraddhas, the ancestors of the persons performing them become purged of all sins. The departed Manes referred to above as those created by the SelfCreate are seven in number.

sa: भवद्भिर्न हि मे मन्युः कृतपूर्वः कथंचन॥ अत्यन्तगुरुभक्तानामेषोऽञ्जलिरिदं नमः।
en: You never cherished any anger again't me on any previous occasion. I join my hands before you who are famous for loyalty. Here, I bow to you all.

sa: यतश्च यद् यथा चैव देवसत्रे महामते। अन्ने दत्ते नरेणेह प्राणा दत्ता भवन्त्युत॥
en: You know why those words were said what those words were, and how they were said in course of the sacred Mantras, O you of great intelligence. A man, by making a gift of food, really makes a gift of life itself.

sa: प्रीतोऽस्मि ते महाप्राज्ञ ब्रूहि किं करवाणि ते। यदीप्सुरुपपन्नस्त्वं तस्य कालोऽयमागतः॥
en: O you of great wisdom. I have become pleased with you. Tell me what I shall do for you. The time has come for the accomplishment of that purpose for which you have come here..

sa: उदवासं वसेद् यस्तु स नराधिपतिर्भवेत्। सत्यवादी नररेष्ठ दैवतैः सह मोदते॥
en: One who passes sometime in Udavasa, mode of life, becomes the very lord of the celestial region. The man who speaks the truth, O best of men, succeeds in sporting happily with the celestials themselves.

sa: अबुद्ध्या नाग्रहीर्यस्त्वं तन्मे सुमहदप्रियम्। न च साद्य पुनर्भूयः स्मृति सम्भविष्यति॥
en: It is greatly disagreeable to me to learn that you did not, from folly, receive what I gave. The recollection of all that I told you on that occasion will not come to me now.

sa: अधर्मिष्ठानपि सतः कुन्तीपुत्रा महारथाः॥ मानवान् पालयिष्यन्ति भूत्वा धर्मपरायणाः।
en: Those powerful car-warriors, viz., the sons of Kunti, themselves devoted to the duties of virtue, will protect and cherish the people even if these happen to be unrighteous.

sa: तथार्जुनस्तीव्रदुःखाभितप्तो मुहुर्मुहुनिःश्वसन् भारताग्र्यः। युधिष्ठिरं मैवमित्येवमुक्त्वा निगृह्याथो दीनवत् सीदमानः॥
en: Arjuna, burning with great grief, sighed repeatedly. That foremost of Bharata princes, telling Yudhishthira that he should not behave thus, stood cheerlessly and with heart plunged into distress.

sa: असपत्नां महीं भुङ्क्ते धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। भीमसेनानुभावेन यमयोश्च नरोत्तम॥
en: And, O best of men, the virtuous king Yudhishthira now enjoys the sovereignty of the earth without a rival, by the power of Bhimasena and the twin brothers.

sa: आश्वासितोऽहं प्राग्वृद्धैर्भवद्भिर्मुनिपुङ्गवैः। न सूक्ष्ममपि मे किंचिद् व्यलीकमिह विद्यते॥
en: I have been consoled by the words of so great, ancient and aged saints as your solves, and I have now no cause left for the least sorrow.

sa: गण्डोवाच उग्रदितो भयाद् यस्माद् बिभ्यतीमे ममेश्वराः। बलीयांसो दुर्बलवद् विभेम्यहमतः परम्॥
en: Ganda said When these my lords, who are gifted with great energy, are so very much afraid of this when seems to be a great terror, weak as I am, I fear it the more.

sa: तस्मान्यायागतैरथैर्धर्मे सेवेत पण्डितः॥ धर्म एको मनुष्याणां सहाय: परिलौकिकः।
en: Hence, an intelligent man should always seek to acquire virtue through wealth acquired by fair means. Virtue is the one only friend whichcrcatures have in the next world.

sa: क्षत्ता च धर्मार्थविदग्र्यबुद्धिः ससंजयस्तं नृपति सदारम्। उपायरद् घोरतपो जितात्मा तदा कृशो वल्कलचीरवासाः॥
en: Vidura, conversant with the true interpretations of Virtue, and gifted with great intelligence, as also Sanjaya, waited upon the old king with his wife. Both of them with souls under control, Vidura and Sanjaya also reduced themselves, and wore barks and rags.

sa: भरद्वाज उवाच नैतस्येह यथास्माकं ब्रह्मबन्धोरचेतसः। शोको भार्यापवादेन तेन पावाञ्छना सह॥
en: Bharadvaja said This man has no regret like ours for having condemned and cursed his wife. He has not acted so wickedly and foolishly. Hence I see both him and his dog so well formed.

sa: वृत्तशौचं मनःशौचं तीर्थशौचमतः परम्। ज्ञानोत्पन्नं च यच्छौचं तच्छौचं परमं स्मृतम्॥
en: Purity of conduct forms the purity of the mind. The purity that one acquires by ablutions in sacred waters is considered as inferior. Indeed that purity which originates from knowledge, is considered as the best.

sa: प्रवेक्ष्यति महात्मानं विदुरश्च युधिष्ठिरम्। संजयस्तदनुध्यानादितः स्वर्गमवाप्स्यति॥
en: Vidura will enter into the high souled Yudhishthira. Sanjaya also, through meditation, will ascend from this world into the celestial region.

sa: तं श्रुत्वा भृशसंतप्तं देवराजो बृहस्पतिम्। अधिगम्यामरवृतः प्रोवाचेदं वचस्तदा।॥
en: And when the king of the gods came to know that Brihaspati was much aggrieved, he went to him attended by the Immortals and spoke to him thus.

sa: सहस्रभुजभृच्छ्रीमान् कार्तवीर्योऽभवत् प्रभुः। अस्य लोकस्य सर्वस्य माहिष्मत्यां महाबलः॥
en: Gifted with a thousand arms and great beauty the powerful Kartavirya, formerly became the lord of all the world. He had his capital in the city of Mahishmati.

sa: सुधारसकृताहारः श्रीमान् सर्वमनोहरः॥ तेजसा वपुषा लक्ष्म्या भ्राजते रश्मिवानिव।
en: There he lives upon ambrosia. Gifted with a beautiful form highly agreeable to all, he shines with energy and prosperity like the sun himself of a thousand rays.

sa: समृद्धरथहस्त्यश्वं वेणुवीणानुनादितम्। शुशुभे पाण्डवं सैन्यं तत् तदा भरतर्षभ॥
en: Teeming with cars and elephants and horses, and echoing with the blare of trumpets and the music of Vinas, the Pandav army, O monarch, shone with great beauty.

sa: इत्युक्तवत्यां गान्धार्यो कुन्ती व्रतकृशानना॥ प्रच्छन्नजातं पुत्रं तं सस्मारादित्यसंनिधम्।
en: After Gandhari had said so, Kunti, whose face had become waste through observance of many hard vows, began to think of her secretborn son gifted with solar effulgence.

sa: तामृषिर्वरदो व्यासो दूरश्रवणदर्शनः॥ अपश्यद् दुःखितां देवीं मातरं सव्यसाचिनः।
en: The boon-giving Rishi Vyasa capable of both seeing and hearing what took place at a remote distance, saw that the royal mother of Arjuna was afflicted with grief.

sa: अतिथीनन्नपानेन कामैरन्यैरकिंचनान्। विदितं वेदितव्यं ते कर्तव्यमपि ते कृतम्॥
en: Do you also please your guests with meat and drink and the poor with gifts after their hearts. A person of your high intelligence should not act thus.

sa: प्रत्यक्षं प्रीतिजननं भोक्तुनुर्भवत्युत। सर्वाण्यन्यानि दानानि परोक्षफलवन्त्युत॥
en: A gift of food readily yields the happiness of both the giver and the receiver. All other gifts produce unseen fruits.

sa: कालोदकं नन्दिकुण्डं तथा चोत्तरमानसम्। अभ्येत्य योजनशताद् भ्रूणहा विप्रमुच्यते॥
en: Starting for Kalodaka and Nandikunda and Uttaramanasa, and reaching a spot that is hundred Yojanas remote from any of them, one becomes purged of the sin of foeticide.

sa: न ज्येष्ठो वावमन्येत दुष्कृतः सुकृतोऽपि वा। यदि स्त्री यद्यवरजः श्रेयश्चेत् तत् तदाचरेत्॥
en: If the eldest brother happens to be a vicious man and without any accomplishments, he inay be disregarded by his younger brothers. If the wife or the younger brother happens to be sinful, her or his good must still be looked alier.

sa: ब्राह्मणो हि महद्भूतं स्वयं देहीति याचति। अकायो वा सकामो वा दत्त्वा पुण्यमवाप्नुयात्॥
en: The Brahmana is a great being. When he comes into one's house and solicits, saying, Give me!the owner of the house, whether actuated or not by the desire of gaining merit, is sure to win great merit by listening to that prayer.

sa: रामह्रद उपस्पृश्य विपाशायां कृतोदकः। द्वादशाहं निराहारः कल्मषाद् विप्रमुच्यते॥
en: Bathing in Ramahrada and offering oblations of water to the departed manes in the river Vipasha (Beas), and fasting for twelve days, one becomes purged of all sins.

sa: तस्यान्तरिक्षं पृथिवी दिवं च सर्वे वशे तिष्ठति शाश्वतस्य। स कुम्भे रेतः ससृजे सुराणां यत्रोत्पन्नमृषिमाहुर्वसिष्ठम्॥
en: He is eternal, and it is under that illustrious one that the Sky, Earth, Heaven, all things exist and stay. He it was who caused the vital seed of the gods Mitra and Varuna to fall within a jar, whence originated thc Rishi known by the name of Vasishtha.

sa: पूज्या हि ज्ञानविज्ञानतपोयोगसमन्विताः। तेभ्यः पूजां प्रयुञ्जीथा ब्राह्मणेभ्यः परंतप॥
en: Gifted with knowledge and spiritual vision and penances and Yoga, such persons always deserve our adoration. O scorcher of enemies, do you always offer adoration to such Brahmanas.

sa: स विहायो व्यदधात् पञ्चनाभिः स निर्ममे गां दिवमन्तरिक्षम्। सोऽरण्यानि व्यसृजत् पर्वतांश्च हृषीकेशोऽमितदीप्ताग्नितेजाः॥ अलंघयद् वै सरितो जिघांसन् शक्रं वज्रं प्रहरन्तं निरास स महेन्द्रः स्तूयते वै महाध्वरे विगैरेको ऋक्सहस्रः पुराणैः॥
en: It is this Krishna who is the refuge of the five original elements with the sky among them. It is he who created the Earth and Heaven and the intervening space. Indeed, it is the Krishna of immeasurable and burning energy who has created the forests and the mountains. It is this Krishna who, desirous of punishing Shakra who was about to hurl his thunder at him, crossed the rivers and at once paralysed him. He is the one great Indra who is worshipped by the Brahmanas in great sacrifices with the help of a thousand old Richs.

sa: वैमानिक उपस्पृश्य किङ्किणीकाश्रमे तथा। निवासेऽप्सरसां दिव्ये कामचारी महीयते॥
en: Bathing in Vaimanika and Kinkinika, one acquires the power of going everywhere at will and becomes an object of great respect in the celestial region of the Apsaras.

sa: ज्योतींषि शुक्लानि हि सर्वलोके त्रयो लोका लोकपालास्त्रयश्च। त्रयोऽग्नयो व्याहृतयश्च तिस्रः सर्वे देवा देवकीपुत्र एव॥
en: He is the white rays of light which are seen in all the worlds. He is the threc worlds. He is the thrce Regents of all the worlds. He is the threc sacrificial fires He is the three Vyahritis; indeed, this son of Devaki is all the gods together.

sa: ज्योतिर्भूतः परमोऽसौ पुरस्तात् प्रकाशते यत्प्रभया विश्वरूपः। अप: सृष्ट्वा सर्वभूतात्मयोनिः पुराकरोत् सर्वमेवाथ विश्वम्॥
en: He is of the form of the most resplendent light. Of universal form, this Krishna is shorn in that blazing cffulgence. The original cause of the soul of all existent crcatures, he at first created the waters. Afterwards he created this universe.

sa: तास्त्वां वयं प्रणम्येह याचामो मधुसूदन। कुलस्यास्य हितार्थं तं कुरु कल्याणमुत्तमम्॥
en: O destroyer of Madhu, bowing our heads to you, we pray you for making those words of Abhimanyu true! In view also of the time that has come, do you accomplish what is highly beneficial.

sa: महादेव उवाच स्वैरिणस्तपसा देवि सर्वे दारविहारिणः। तेषां मौण्ड्यं कषायश्च वासे रात्रिश्च कारणम्॥
en: Mahadeva said O goddess, the shaving of the head and the wearing of the brown robes are the characteristics of those recluses who rove about freely; while the characteristics of those who sport with wives consist in passing their nights at home.

sa: एतच्छुत्वा तु विपुलो नापश्यद् धर्मसंकरम्। जन्मप्रभृति कौरव्य कृतपूर्वमथात्मनः॥
en: Hearing these words, however, Vipula, although he tried earnestly to recollect, could not remember any sin of his from even his earliest years, O you of Kuru's race.

sa: ततः सेनापतिरभूद् द्रोणोऽस्त्रविदुषां वरः। प्रवीरः कौरवेन्द्रस्य काव्यो दैत्यपतेरिव॥
en: Then Drona, that foremost of all persons conversant with arms, that greatest of men under Duryodhana, like Kavya himself of the lord of the Daityas, became the Commanderin-chief.

sa: सुखं वसति धर्मात्मा दिवि देवगणैः सह। वीरलोकगतो नित्यं वीरयोगसहः सदा॥ सत्त्वस्थः सर्वमुत्सृज्य दीक्षितो नियतः शुचिः। वीराध्वानं प्रपद्येद् यस्तस्य लोकाः सनातनाः॥
en: Indeed, that pious person lives happily in Heaven, with the celestials as his companions. The hero, following the practices of heroes and devoted to that Yoga which belongs to heroes, living in the practice of Goodness, having renounced everything performed the initiation, controlled his senses, and observing purity of both body and mind, is sure to acquire that path which is reserved for heroes. Eternal regions of happiness are his.

sa: अश्वश्चोत्सृज्यतामद्य पृथ्व्यामथ यथाक्रमम्। सुगुप्तं चरतां चापि यथाशास्त्रं यथाविधि॥
en: Let the horse also be loosened today, for wandering on the Earth, according to the ordinances of the scriptures. Let the animal, duly protected, wander over the Earth.

sa: अभिप्रेता च या यस्य तस्मै देया युधिष्ठिर। गान्धर्वमिति तं धर्मं प्राहुर्वेदविदो जनाः॥
en: When the father of the girl, without consulting his wishes, confers his own daughter upon a person whom the daughter likes and who reciprocates the girl's sentiments, the form of marriage, O Yudhishthira, is called Gandharva by those versed in the Vedas.

sa: तं विकर्णः शरैस्तीक्ष्णैर्गध्रपत्रैरजिह्मगैः। विव्याध परवीरनमर्जुनं धृतराष्ट्रजः॥
en: Then with sharp and straight arrows having the wings of vultures, Dhritarashtra's son Vikarana sounded Arjuna, the slayer of hostile heroes.

sa: दोषं ह्येषां नाध्यगच्छं परीच्छन् नित्यं कंचिद् येन ग¥य पार्थान्। धर्मार्थाभ्यां कर्म कुर्वन्ति नित्यं सुखप्रिये नानुरुध्यन्ति कामात्॥
en: Never did I observe any questionable act in them. Though I was always on the look-out, yet never did I find anything done by these sons of Pritha for which we could blame them. They always work for the sake of virtue and their own interests and never request others for : their own well being.

sa: पाण्डवा मृगयाशीलाश्चरन्तस्तन्महद् वनम्। विजहुरिन्द्रप्रतिमाः कञ्चित् कालमरिंदम॥
en: Those Indra-like Pandavas, fond of hunting and subdues of their enemies, lived there for some time wandering in that huge forest.

sa: घुष्यतां राजधानीषु सर्वसम्पन्महीक्षिताम्। पृथिवी भ्रातृभावेन भुज्यतां विज्वरो भव॥
en: Proclaim it in the several capitals and among all the rulers of the earth; enjoy the sovereignty of the earth like brothers and be freed from all troubles.

sa: तच्छतान्यपि भुञ्जन्ति ब्राह्मणानां मनीषिणाम्। मुनेस्त्यागविशुद्ध्या तु तदन्नं वृद्धिमृच्छति॥
en: By virtue of the pure spirit in which the Rishi gave away (food), it increased so much that hundreds upon hundreds of leanred Brahmanas were fed with it.

sa: प्रातीपः शान्तनुस्तात कुलस्यार्थ यथा स्थितः। यथा देवव्रतो भीष्मः कुलस्यार्थं स्थितोऽभवत्॥
en: As Shantanu, the son of Pratipa, ever acted with the interests of his race at heart and as Bhishma, who had taken a divine vow, ever acted with the interests of his race at heart,

sa: एतच्च मरणं तात यन्मत्तः पतितादिव। ज्ञातयो विनिवर्तन्ते प्रेतसत्त्वादिवासवः॥
en: This I regard as death to me, O Sire, since from me the cousins away as from a fallen creature or breath forsakes an animal that is dead.

sa: मा नः कुले वैरकृत् कश्चिदस्तु राजाऽमात्यो मा परस्वापहारी। मित्रद्रोही नैकृतिकोऽनृती वा पूर्वाशी वा पितृदेवातिथिभ्यः॥
en: Let none in our family be a creator of enemies; let none be a minister to the king; none, a thief stealing other's property; none, an enemy of his well-wisher; none, deceitful; none be addicted to falsehood; and none eat before making offerings to his ancestors, gods or guests.

sa: ते तु तत्रैव राजानः सिद्धाश्चाप्सरसस्तथा। अपश्यन्त निरालम्बं तं ययाति परिच्युतम्॥
en: All the kings who were there (in heaven) as also those who had obtained salvation and the Apasaras laughed at Yayati being hurled down from heaven and falling down, having you support to cling to.

sa: नाध्यवास्यद् यदा कश्चित् सागरस्य विलङ्घनम्॥ ततः पितरमाविश्य पुप्लवेऽहं महार्णवम्। शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं निहत्य जलराक्षसीम्॥
en: But none had courage enough to attempt it. Then inspired with the energy of my father, whom I invoked, I crossed the vast ocean, a thousand yojanas wide, after having killed a Rakshasa woman (on my way) who lived in the waters.

sa: शिबीनिक्ष्वाकुमुख्यांश्च त्रिगर्तान् सैन्धवानपि। जघानातिरथः संख्ये बाणगोचरमागतान्॥
en: That great warrior slew with shafts in battle, the leader of the Ikshvakus, the army of the Shibis, Trigarta and Saindhava.

sa: धर्मशास्त्रातिगो मूढो दुरात्मा प्रचग्रहं गतः। अनेयः श्रेयसां मन्दो धार्तराष्ट्रो जनार्दन॥
en: The wicked-souled fool, the son of Dhritarashtra, goes against the rules laid down in our books of religion; being overtaken by fate he is incapable of being led by his superiors and is a fool.

sa: शिशुभिर्दुर्जयैः संख्ये द्रौपदेयैर्महात्मभिः। आशीविषसमस्पर्शः पाण्डवा अभ्ययुञ्जत॥
en: With the children hard to vanquish, the sons of Draupadi of noble souls, who are like snakes, will the Pandavas fight.

sa: त्वामाहुरेकं कवयस्त्वामाहुस्त्रिविधं पुनः। त्वया त्यक्तं जगच्चेदं सद्यो नश्येद्भुताशन॥
en: The poets sang of you as the one and then again as the three. O you consumer of offerings, bereft of you this world is at once annihilated.

sa: दभिज्ञातः सर्वधर्मोपपन्नः। स तं दुष्टुमनुशिष्यात् प्रजानां न चैतद् बुध्येदिति तस्मिन्नसाधुः॥
en: If there is any body superior to him (the king) and known to be endued with all virtues, he should instruct his subjects to see him. A bad king will not however observe all this.

sa: आत्मज्ञानं समारम्भणततिक्षा धर्मनित्यता। यमर्थान्नापकर्षन्ति स वै पण्डित उच्यते॥
en: He is said to be a wise man whom anger, exultation, pride, shame, stupefaction and vanity cannot draw aside from the acquisition of the high ends in life.

sa: विशालं पृथिवीराज्यं क्षेमं निहतकण्टकम्। प्रतिगृहणीष्व मत्तस्त्वं साधु ब्राह्मणपुङ्गव॥
en: O most exalted of the Brahmanas, may you be in peace. Accept from me the extensive and peaceful empire of the world with its thorns (enemies) weeded out.

sa: मन्त्राहुतिमहाहोमैहूयमानश्च पावकः। प्रदक्षिणमुखो भूत्वा विधूमः समपद्यत॥
en: The fire, too, on which had been offered Homa libations accompanied by incantations, became bright and smokeless inclining towards the right.

sa: निर्माता सर्वलोकानामीश्वरः सर्वकर्मवित्। यस्य नारायणो बन्धुरर्जुनो दुःसहो युधि॥
en: Arjuna, whose friend is Narayana, the creator of the entire world and its lord and conversant with the nature of all acts, is hard to withstand in battle.

sa: कर्ण उवाच नैवमायुष्मता वाच्यं यन्मामात्थ पितामह। क्षत्रधर्मे स्थितो ह्यस्मि स्वधर्मादनपेयिवान्॥
en: Karna said It is not proper for you, O grandfather, to say to me the words you have spoken. I observe the rules of the Kshatriya caste and am not fallen from my own virtue.

sa: असूयको दन्दशूको निष्ठुरो वैरकृच्छठः। स कृच्छ्रे महदाप्नोति न चिरात् पापमाचरन्॥
en: A man that is envious, one that gravely injures another, one who is cruel, one who is always making enemies of others and one who is deceitful by committing sins, soon meets with grave difficulties.

sa: प्रपद्यस्व महाबाहुं कृष्णमक्लिष्टकारिणम्। प्रसन्नो हि सुखाय स्यादुभयोरेव केशवः॥
en: Seek the refuge of that one of long arms Krishna, who does everything without exertions; if Keshava gratified it will conduce to the happiness of both the sides.

sa: भीमसेनमुपाश्लिष्यद्धस्तिनीव महागजम्। वीणेव मधुरालापा गान्धारं साधु मूर्छती। अभ्यभाषत पाञ्चाली भीमसेनमनिन्दिता॥
en: Having embraced Bhimasena as a sheelephant embraces her mighty mate, that faultless daughter of Panchala, possessed of a voice sweet as the sound of a Vina, sounding out clearly the Gandharva tune addressed Bhimasena thus.

sa: उपसृत्याब्रुवं चार्यामभिगम्य रहोगताम्। सीते रामस्य दूतोऽहं वानरो मारुतात्मजः॥
en: I approached her and bowing down to that worshipful lady who was alone, said “Sita, I am Ram's messenger, a monkey and the son of Pavana (the wind-god).

sa: देतादृशे क्षत्रियसंनिवेशे। यस्त्वाद्य पातालमुखे पतन्तं पाणौ गृहीत्वा प्रतिसंहरेत्॥
en: Me-thinks, there is none in this assemblage of Kshatriyas who can hold you by hand to save from falling into the pit you have dug under your feet.

sa: इत्युक्तः स तथेत्युक्त्वा रथमास्थाय दंशितः। प्रययाविन्द्रजिद् राजस्तूर्ममायोधनं प्रति॥
en: O king, thus addressed (by his father), Indrajita replied “it shall be so" and donning his armour and riding on his car, he soon marched towards the battle-field.

sa: इन्द्रसेनाद्रयश्चैव यथोक्ताः प्राप्य यादवान्। रथानश्वांश्च रक्षन्तः सुखमूषुः सुसंवृताः॥
en: Indrasena and others as mentioned before, after having gone to the Yadavas spent their days happily and privately in looking after the horses and cars of the Pandavas.

sa: एतद्धि रुचिराकारैः प्रासादैरुपशोभितम्। शिवं च रमणीयं च सर्वर्तुसुमहाधनम्॥
en: This one (the abode of Dushasana) is graced with many palaces beautiful to look at; and it is comfortable, enchanting and rich during every season of the year.

sa: तदेवं बहुमानात् ते मयेहानीप्सितं कृतम्। सुकृतं दुष्कृतं वात्वं माहात्म्यात् क्षन्तुमर्हसि॥
en: Out of great respect (for you) did I entertain the thought and whether I did right or wrong, it is fitting that out of your own generosity and noble mindedness you should forgive me. in

sa: सकाण्डदण्डकाः सर्वे ससीरविषतोमराः। सशूर्पपिटकाः सर्वे सदात्राङ्कुशतोमराः॥
en: With staffs having thorns or barbs fixed to them, weapons for thrcwing poison, and sloughs, as also devices for hurling javelins;

sa: अकीर्ति विनयो हन्ति हन्त्यनर्थं पराक्रमः। हन्ति नित्यं क्षमा क्रोधमाचारो हन्त्यलक्षणम्॥
en: And having heard the opinions of other men seen and known the life of the men, a wise man forms friendship with wise men. Humility removes bad repute and prowess puts an end to adversity.

sa: विभ्राजमानां रूपमुत्तमम्। भ्राजयन्तीं वनोद्देशं नीलाभ्रमिव विद्युतम्॥
en: She appeared in her form having the most excellent beauty, shedding lustre on woodland like lightning illuminating masses of dark clouds.

sa: दानवा घोरकर्माणो निवातकवचा युधि। रौद्रमस्त्रं समादाय दग्धा वानरकेतुना॥
en: Those Danavas of fierce deeds called Nivatakavachas were consumed by him, who has the emblem of monkeys on his banner, in battle with a number of fierce weapons.

sa: अप्येवाहं निराहारा जीवितप्रियवर्जिता। शोषयिष्यामि गात्राणि व्याली तालगता यथा॥
en: Separated from my beloved, so dear to my life I will rather live without food and waste away my frame like a she-serpent living near a Tala tree.

sa: यस्य ज्याक्षेपकठिनौ बाहू परिघसंनिभौ। स शङ्खपरिपूर्णाभ्यां शोचन्नास्ते धनंजयः॥
en: That Dhananjaya, whose arms are likes inaces of iron and are marked by the strokes of the bow-string, is living in grief with his wrists covered with conch-bracelets.

sa: अमोक्षयित्वा वैदेहीमहत्वा च रणे रिपून्। हृतदारोऽवधूतश्च नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे॥
en: Deprived of my wife and honour, I do not wish to live so long as the princess of Videha is not rescued and my enemies are not slain."

sa: अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। विरोचनस्य संवादं केशिन्यर्थं सुधन्वना॥
en: As an instance of this is cited the old story about the conversation between Virochana and Sudhanvan, suitors of Keshini's hand.

sa: ह्रीनिषेवो निपुणः सत्यवादी महाबलः सर्वधर्मोपपन्नः। गान्धारिमार्छस्तुमुले क्षिप्रकारी क्षेप्ता जनान् सहदेवस्तरस्वी॥
en: When Sahadeva who is modest, skillful in battle truthful, of great strength and graced with all virtues, active, capable of speedily doing things, meets the son of Gandhara in terrible and fells down his men.

sa: न चैष शक्तः पार्थानां यस्त्वमर्थमभीप्ससि। सूतपुत्रो दृढक्रोधो भ्राता दुःशासनश्च ते॥
en: You desire to possess yourself of the wealth of the sons of Pritha but you are not competent to do it, nor is the son of the Suta, nor your brother Dushasana of firm wrath,

sa: रथपत्तिगजोदग्रं महोर्मिभिरवाकुलम्॥ धावतामाह्वयानानां तनुत्राणि च बनताम्।
en: The army, composed of chariots, infantry and cavalry, with the soldiers running about summoning one another and buckling on their Armour.

sa: सर्पश्चाग्निश्च सिंहश्च कुलपुत्रश्च भारत। नावज्ञेया मनुष्येण सर्वे ह्येतेऽतितेजसः॥
en: A serpent, the fire, a lion and a cousin, O Bharata, are not to be disregarded by a man. All of them are really possessed of great power.

sa: गतिर्भव त्वं देवानां सेन्द्राणाममरोत्तम। जगद् व्याप्तमिदं सर्वं वृत्रेणासुरसूदन॥
en: O you best among the immortals, be the means of salvation of the gods including Indra. O you slayer of Asuras, the entire world is pervaded by Vritra.

sa: अथ ते धर्ममुत्सृज्य युद्धमिच्छन्ति पाण्डवाः। आसाद्येमान् कुरुश्रेष्ठान् स्मरिष्यन्ति वचो मम॥
en: If the sons of Pandu, bidding adieu to a righteous course, desire war, then will they, after coming face to face with these foremost among the race of Kurus, have occasion to remember my words.

sa: ततस्ता नर्तनागाराद् विनिष्क्रम्य सहार्जुनाः। कन्या ददृशुरायान्तीं क्लिष्टां कृष्णामनागसम्॥
en: Then coming out with Arjuna from the dancing hall, those daughters saw the innocent saw Krishna (though) sorely persecuted coming. Beholding her arrive there they all delightedly said.

sa: अस्मिन्नभ्यागते काले किं च नः क्षममच्युत। कथं च वर्तमाना वै स्वधर्मान्न च्यवेमहि॥
en: "Under the present circumstances which have developed before us, what should we do, O you who never go away from the right path; and by shaping our course in what way shall we not fall off from the duties of our class.

sa: सर्वे निवारयामासुर्देवापेरभिषेचनम्। स तच्छ्रुत्वा तु नृपतिरभिषेकनिवारणम्। अश्रुकण्ठोऽभवद् राजा पर्यशोचत चात्मजम्॥
en: All dissuaded him from installing Devapi; and that ruler of men, having heard of the exclusion of his elder son from the installation, had his voice choked with tears and became sorrowful for his son.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच एवमेतन्महाबाहो रामेणामिततेजसा। प्राप्तं व्यसनमत्युचं वनवासकृतं पुरा॥
en: Markandeya said: O mighty-armed one, thus, in days of old Rama of unrivalled energy had experienced such a terrible disaster owing to his being exiled in the forests.

sa: अहन्यहनि भूतानि गच्छन्तीह यमालयम्। शेषाः स्थावरमिच्छन्ति किमाश्चर्यमतः परम्॥
en: In this world day by day (innumerable) creatures are going to the abode of Yama. Yet they that remain desire immortality. What can be more marvelous than this?

sa: तिष्ठ तात सतां वाक्ये सुहृदामर्थवादिनाम्। वृद्धं शान्तनवं भीष्मं तितिक्षस्व पितामहम्॥
en: Abide then, my dear, by what your friends who tell you to do only what is conducive to your interests say. Accept the old Bhishma, the son of Shantanu and your grandfather as your guides.

sa: शैलं प्रति बलाभ्राणि व्याप्तानीवार्करश्मिभिः॥ अशोकानां वनानीवच्छननानि बहुशः शुभैः।
en: Like the newly risen clouds on a mountain, filled with the rays of the sun or like the gioves of the Ashoka trees covered with full blown flowers.

sa: अथ कालस्य पर्याये वृद्धो नृपतिसत्तमः। सम्भारानभिषेकार्थं कारयामास शास्त्रतः॥
en: In course of time, that old king, the best among rulers of men, had all arrangements made for the installation according to the holy books ((of his son).

sa: रथं तमागतं दृष्ट्वा दक्षिणं प्राकरोत् तदा। रथमास्थाय बीभत्सुः कौन्तेयः श्वेतवाहनः॥ बद्धगोधाङ्गुलित्राणः प्रगृहीतशरासनः। ततः प्रायादुदीचिं च कपिप्रवरकेतनः॥
en: Seeing the banner reach his car the hero went round it reverentially. Then getting on his car, Bibhatsu, the son of Kunti, having white steeds and the emblem of a monkey on his banner, having his fingers protected by the gloves of Inguana skin, and taking up his bow and arrows, started in a northerly direction.

sa: एतानेतावतस्तत्र तानपश्यं समागतान्। ये पाण्डवार्थं योत्स्यन्ति धार्तराष्ट्रस्य वाहिनीम्॥
en: These parties and of their respective numbers have I seen come there, who will fight with the army of Dhritarashtra, on behalf of the sons of Pandu. son

sa: त्वमप्येभिर्महेष्वासैः सहायैर्देवरूपिभिः। विजेष्यसे रणे सर्वानमित्रान् भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharatas, with these mighty bowmen of celestials appearance you will surely conquer in battle all your enemies.

sa: त्वमेवाग्ने हव्यवाहस्त्वमेव परमं हविः। जयन्ति सत्रैस्त्वामेव यज्ञैश्च परमाध्वरे॥
en: You are, O god of fire, the receiver of offering and you are yourself the best offering. They worship you in a sacrificial ceremony by the best offerings.

sa: सर्वे ते शत्रवः शक्या न चेज्जीवितुमिच्छसि। अथ चेदीदृशीं वृत्तिं क्लीबवामभ्युपपद्यसे॥
en: All your enemies are capable of being opposed by you; if not, it is not proper that you should live on. You are now following a course of life which is fit only for eunuchs.

sa: निर्विण्णात्मा हतमना मुञ्चैतां पापजीविकाम्। एकशत्रुवधेनैव शूरो गच्छति विश्रुतिम्॥
en: Cast off this wicked and despicable life which you are leading with a troubled soul and depressed heart. By slaying only one enemy does a hero gain renown.

sa: संगतो भरतेनाथ शत्रुघ्नेन च वीर्यवान्॥ राघवः सहसौमित्रिर्मुमुदे भरतर्षभ।
en: Then, O best of the Bharatas, the mighty descendant of Raghu together with the son of Sumitra experienced a great delight on being joined with Bharata and Shatrughna.

sa: सकीलकवचाः सर्वे वासीवृक्षादनान्विताः। व्याघ्रचर्मपरीवारा द्वीपिचर्मावृताश्च ते॥
en: With battle axes, forked lances, sharp spikes, iron gloves with barbs and chariots covered by tiger skins are skins of leopards;

sa: एवं ज्येष्ठोऽप्यथोत्सितो न राज्यमभिजायते। यवीयांसोऽपि जायन्ते राज्यं वृद्धोपसेवया॥
en: Thus can even the eldest son be superseded and deprived of the kingdom; and even a younger son can get the kingdom for his attentions to the aged.

sa: अविजित्य य आत्मानममात्यान् विजिगीषते। अमित्रान् वाजितामात्यः सोऽवशः परिहीयते॥
en: He who desires to bring his advisers under control without controlling himself, who desires to control his enemies without controlling his advisers, at last yields, deprived of strength.

sa: पुरोहितः पाण्डवानां ब्रह्मकर्मण्यवस्थितः। तथैव भ्रातरः पञ्च पाण्डवाः पुरुषर्षभाः॥
en: Let the family priest of the Pandavas ever engaged in the performance of Brahma rites as also the brothers, the five sons of Pandu, these foremost among men,

sa: तेषां बलवतामासीन्महास्त्राणां समागमः। विव्यथुः सकला येन त्रयो लोकाश्चराचराः॥
en: (And thus) there ensued an encounter among those powerful warriors skilled in wielding mighty weapons, which (encounter) sorely afflicted the three worlds with their mobile and immobile creatures.

sa: अश्रुतश्च समुन्नद्धो दरिद्रश्च महामनाः। अर्थाश्चाकर्मणा प्रेप्सुर्मूढ इत्युच्यते बुधैः॥
en: Wise men call them fools, who though not learned are haughty, though poor are vain and who are who are are desirous of attaining prosperity by wrong acts.

sa: सर्वमेतन्न भोक्तव्यमन्नं दुष्टाभिसंहितम्। क्षत्तुरेकस्य भोक्तव्यमिति मे धीयते मतिः॥
en: All these eatables, defiled by wickedness, cannot be taken by me-I am of opinion, that eatables provided to me by Kshatta alone, Vidura should be eaten by me.

sa: विदुर उवाच अतीवगुणसम्पन्नो न जातु विनयान्वितः। सुसूक्ष्ममपि भूतानामुपमर्दमुपेक्षते॥
en: Vidura said He that is exceedingly good and is endued with humility does not neglect even the slightest suffering of any creature (without an attempt at alleviating them).

sa: आपदेवास्य मरणात् पुरुषस्य गरीयसी। श्रियो विनाशस्तद्ध्यस्य निमित्तं धर्मकामयोः॥
en: Poverty is a more potent evil to a man than death; for it destroys his prosperity. Wealth is the source of a man's virtue well as his pleasure.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा सटास्तस्य पञ्च चक्रे वृकोदरः। अर्धचन्द्रेण बाणेन किंचिदब्रुवतस्तदा॥
en: Having said this Vrikodara, with his crescent-shaped arrow, shaved the hair of the king's head keeping five tufts at five places. But (Jayadratha) did not utter a word.

sa: स्वपुरं प्रययौ राजा चतुरङ्गबलानुगः। शोकोपहतया बुद्ध्या चिन्तयानः पराभवम्॥
en: The king (Duryodhana), accompanied by his four kinds of forces went towards his city, his heart rent in grief and his mind filled with thoughts of his defeat.

sa: धुमत्सेनसुतं वीरं सत्यवन्तमनिन्दिता। सावित्र्यनुचचारैका यमलोकं मनस्विनी॥
en: The noble-minded lady of spotless beauty, Savitri, followed the heroic Satyavana, the son of Dyumatsena, alone into the reign of death.

sa: एतदिच्छामि भगवन् कथ्यमानं द्विजोत्तम। परिभ्रष्टः कथं स्वर्गान्नहुषः पापनिश्चयः॥
en: O you best among the twice born, having the six attributes, narrate how Nahusha of vicious purpose came to be ousted from heaven. I want to hear that.

sa: न चास्य सर्वशास्त्राणि प्रभवन्ति निबर्हणे। सोऽभिक्रुध्यति भृत्यानां सुहृदश्चाभ्यसूयति॥
en: His intimacy with all the holy books cannot procure him a mitigation of his sufferings. Sometimes he feels wrathful towards his servants; and afterwards he envies his friends.

sa: ततस्तं रथमास्थाय भीमः पार्थानुगस्तदा। अभ्येत्याश्रममध्यस्थमभ्यगच्छद् युधिष्ठिरम्॥
en: Thereupon placing him on the car, Bhima, followed by Partha, reached the hermitage and approached Yudhishthira who sat in the middle.

sa: पुरोहितोऽयमस्माकमग्निहोत्राणि रक्षतु। सूदपौरोगवैः सार्द्ध दुपदस्य निवेशने॥
en: Let this our priest go back to the house of Drupada with our charioteer and cooks, and preserve our Agnihotra fires.

sa: इन्द्रविष्णुसमावेतौ मन्दात्मा नावबुद्ध्यते। संश्रयाद् द्रोणभीष्माभ्यां कर्णस्य च विकत्थनात्॥
en: They were like Indra and Vishnu seated together. That one of foolish intellect does not understand that owing to his belief in the power of Drona and Bhishma.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच धार्तराष्ट्र जनार्दनः। अभिवीक्ष्य सहामात्यं दाशार्हः प्रहसन्निव॥
en: Vaishampayana said Janardana thus spoken to, said by way of reply to the son of Dhritarashtra, after that scion of the Dasharha race had gazed on him along with his ministers, laughing as it were.

sa: उदतिष्ठत् सहामात्यः पूजयन् मधुसूदनम्। समेत्य धार्तराष्ट्रेण सहामात्येन केशवः॥ राजभिस्तत्र वार्ष्णेयः समागच्छद् यथावयः। तत्र जाम्बूनदमयं पर्यवं सुपरिष्कृतम्॥
en: Rose up along with his advisers, honouring the slayer of Madhu; Keshava having saluted the son of Dhritarashtra along with his ministers; and having also saluted the kings that were there according to their ages, the scion of the Vrishni race ((Achyuta) seated himself on a seat which was there, made of gold and beautiful looking.

sa: अत्रासुरोऽग्निः सततं दीप्यते वारिभोजनः। व्यापारेण धृतात्मानं निबद्धं समबुध्यत॥
en: In these regions, the fire, called Asura fire, which is fed by water, continually blazes forth. Held in great respect, it regards itself as confined (by the gods).

sa: सौभद्रो द्रौपदेयाश्च धृष्टद्युम्नश्च पार्षतः। प्रभद्रकाश्च पञ्चाला भीमसेनमुखा ययुः॥
en: And the son of Subhadra and the (five) sons of Draupadi and Dhrishtadyumna, the son of Parshata race, the Prabhadrakash and the Panchalas under the leadership of Bhimasena.

sa: तस्याचचक्षे गन्धर्वो विश्वावसुरहं नृप। प्राप्तो ब्राह्मणशापेन योनि राक्षससेविताम्॥
en: To him that being replied “O king I am the Gandharva Vishvavasu. I had to assume the shape of a Rakshasa owing to an imprecation of a Brahmana.

sa: नारी विगतकामास्तु कृतार्थाश्च प्रयोजकम्। नावं निस्तीर्णकान्तारा आतुराश्च चिकित्सकम्॥
en: He who attains lordship over the six (desire, anger, grief, stupefaction, pride and vanity) that master of the senses never commits sins-how can he be smitten by grief.

sa: कृतास्त्रं मन्यते बाल आत्मानमविचक्षणः। धार्तराष्ट्रो बलस्थं च पश्यत्यात्मानमातुरः॥
en: That boy thinks himself wise and a master in the use of weapons, and though the son of Dhritarashtra considers himself strong yet in reality he is weak.

sa: महावेग इवोद्भूतो मातरिश्वा बलाहकान्। तेषामग्रप्रदायी स्याः कल्योत्थायी प्रियंवदः॥
en: Like a tempest of great force scattering the clouds. Make payments to them (your allies) before such payments are due, use your energy, and speak to them mildly.

sa: ते त्वां प्रियं करिष्यन्ति पुरोधास्यन्ति च ध्रुवम्। यदैव शत्रुर्जानीयात् सपन्नं त्यक्तजीवितम्। तदैवास्मादुद्विजते सर्पाद् वेश्मगतादिव॥
en: Then will they do what is desirable to you and will surely stand before you to take on themselves the charge of the battle). As soon as the enemy knows that you have grown careless of life, he will begin to fear you as a snake entering his house.

sa: ततस्तन्मतमाज्ञाय केशवस्य पुरःसराः। प्रसस्रुर्योजयिष्यन्तो रथं चक्रगदाभृतः॥
en: Knowing his wishes, the attendants of Keshava, the wielder of the mace and the discus, employed themselves in yoking the car.

sa: ब्राह्मणांस्तर्पयिष्यामि गोभिरश्वैर्धनेन च। यदा परिकरिष्यन्ति ऐणेयानिव तन्तुना। अतरित्रानिव जले बाहुभिर्मामका रणे॥ पश्यन्तस्ते परांस्तत्र रथनागसमाकुलान्। तदा दविमोक्ष्यन्ति पाण्डवाः स च केशवः॥
en: Shall we worship the Brahmanas and with cows and heroes and wealth. When like deer dragged by a net or men unable to him by water shall our soldiers by means of their arms in the battle, drag the enemies and when they (the enemies) see the vast crows of chariots and elephants, then will the sons of Pandu leave off their pride and not they alone but Keshava also.

sa: ब्रह्मघोषाश्च भूयांसः पूर्णाहुत्यस्तथैव च। क्रतवश्च भविष्यन्ति भूयांसो भूरिदक्षिणाः॥
en: There the Vedic hymns are chanted all over, sacrifices are performed, the last full libations are offered to clarified butter and the gifts to Brahmanas are always abundant.

sa: ब्रूयादप्रतिरूपाणि यथा मां वक्तुमर्हसि। तस्मादिदं प्रवक्ष्यामि वचनं वृष्णिनन्दन॥
en: Would dare speak in such unbecoming language as you have deemed fit to address me? Therefore, O you delighted of the Vrishni race, I tell you these words.

sa: विभीषणाधिपती पुरस्कृत्याथ लक्ष्मणः। दक्षिणं नगरद्वारमवामृद्गाद् दुरासदम्॥
en: Then Lakshmana with Vibhishana and the lord of the bears (Jambuvana) marching ahead, demolished the impregnable southern gate of the city.

sa: अनीपुंर्गुप्तदाश्च संविभागी प्रियंवदः। श्लक्ष्णो मधुरवाक् स्त्रीणां न चासां वशगो भवेत्॥१०
en: One should live without showing envy, protect his wife, divide everything property and suitably, be of sweet speech and be mild and sweet in his address to his wife and yet be not her slave.

sa: लोकसाक्षिकमेतन्मे महात्म्यं दिक्षु विश्रुतम्। आश्वासनार्थं भक्तः प्रोक्तं न श्लाघया नृप॥
en: The world is a witness to this greatness of mine, the fame of which has been heard by them. All this has been spoken for consoling you and not by way of self praise, Oking.

sa: अयं ते पुण्डरीकाक्ष दुःशासनकरोद्धृतः। स्मर्तव्यः सर्वकार्येषु परेषां संधिमिच्छता॥
en: O you with lotus-like eyes, desirous of peace with the enemy, you should remember in all your acts that these (tresses) were seized by the hands of Dushasana.

sa: नतन्द्रितश्चन्द्रमाश्चाभ्युपैति। अतन्द्रितो दहते जातवेदाः समिद्धयमानः कर्म कुर्वन् प्रजाभ्यः॥
en: The sleepless moon, too, goes through half months and months and certain peculiar positions of the moon (through work) burns, doing good to the creatures of the Earth.

sa: सन्ति नैकतमा भूयः सुहृदस्तव संजय। सुखदुःखसहा वीर संग्रामादनिवर्तिनः॥
en: You have got many hence well wishers, O Sanjaya, who are heroes, competent equally to endure happiness and misery and who would not turn back from the field.

sa: कुन्त्युवाच यस्यास्त्वीदृशकं वाक्यं श्रुत्वाऽपि स्वल्पचेतसः। तमस्त्वपागमत् तस्य सुचित्रार्थपदाक्षरम्॥
en: Kunti said Hearing this her speech pregnant with sense and consisting of weighty letters and words, the despair that had overtaken him, feeble-minded as he was, immediately vanquished.

sa: हनुमत्प्रमुखाश्चापि विश्रान्तास्ते प्लवङ्गमाः। अभिजग्मुर्हरीन्द्रं तं रामलक्ष्मणसंनिधौ॥
en: (Meanwhile) those monkeys with Hanuman at their head, having rested themselves, were approached the monkey-king who was with Rama and Lakshmana.

sa: बाहुवीर्यार्जितं राज्यमश्नीयामिति कामये। ततो वैश्रवणः प्रीतो विस्मितः समपद्यत॥
en: I desire to get a kingdom, which shall have been earned by the prowess of my arms; then was Vaisravana still more gratified and was struck with wonder.

sa: धार्तराष्ट्रस्य वार्ष्णेय शस्त्रयज्ञो भविष्यति। अस्य यज्ञस्य वेत्ता त्वं भविष्यसि जनार्दन॥
en: O you scion of the Vrishni race, there will be a sacrificial ceremony of weapons performed by the son of Dhritarashtra and in that sacrifice (the supervisor of the ceremonies) will be yourself, O Janardana.

sa: धृतराष्ट्रकुले कृष्ण दुर्योधनसमाश्रयात्। मया त्रयोदश समा भुक्तं राज्यमकण्टकम्॥
en: In the family of Dhritarashtra, O Krishna, owing to my being under the protection of Duryodhana, has sovereignty been enjoyed by me for thirteen years without any thorn.

sa: दुःशासनस्तूपहतोऽभिशस्तो नावर्तते मन्युवशात् कृतघ्नः। न कस्यचिन्मित्रमथो दुरात्मा कलाश्चैता अधमस्येह पुंसः॥
en: Hard to get under control, unable to wear a soft look, owing to rage, when wounded by arms, ungrateful and incapable of being anybody's friend-these are the signs of an inferior man is this world.

sa: न ह्यहं सम्प्रयास्यामि पुरं शत्रुनिराकृतः। शत्रुमानापहो भूत्वा सुहृदां मानकृत् तथा॥
en: Insulted as I am by the enemy I shall never again return to that city; I was ever respected and feared by my enemy, I who ever enhanced the respect of my friends and relatives,

sa: शरजालेन महता वर्षमाणमिवाम्बुदम्॥ तयोर्देवासुरसमः संनिपातो महानभूत्।
en: With a downpour of shafts like the raincharged clouds. There ensued a mighty encounter like that between the gods and demons.

sa: ततो दुर्योधनं हत्वा प्रतिपत्स्ये वसुन्धराम्। कामं मत्स्यमुपास्तां हि कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥
en: If the Matsya's side with him, I shall kill them too; and then slaying Duryodhana, I shall regain the earth; let Kunti's son Yudhishthira continue to pay his homage to the king of the Matsya's.

sa: तदहं भ्रातृसहितः सर्वान् विज्ञापयामि वः। नान्यथा तद्धि कर्तव्यमस्मत्स्नेहानुकम्पया॥
en: I with my brothers, would ask all of you to do one thing. For the sake of the love you bear for us; you should not act otherwise.

sa: विविंशतिं चित्रसेनमादायान्ये विदुद्रुवुः। विन्दानुविन्दावपरे राजदारांश्च सर्वशः॥
en: Some seized Vivenshati and Chitrasena and some Vinda and Anuvinda and some again seized all the ladies of the royal household.

sa: एकाहात् पृथिवी तेनधर्मनित्येनधीमता। विजिता शासनादेव सरत्नाकरपत्तना॥
en: That intelligent king conquered and ruled with virtuous laws the earth with cities and with the sea, the abode of gems.

sa: आजगवं नामधनुः शराः शृङ्गोद्भवाश्च ये। अभेद्यं कवचं चैव सद्यस्तमुपशिश्रियुः॥ सोऽभिषिक्तो मघवता स्वयं शक्रेण भारत। धर्मेण व्यजयल्लोकांस्त्रीन् विष्णुरिव विक्रमैः॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, the bow, celebrated all over the world by the name of Ajagava and a large number of arrows made of horn, also an impenetrable armour, all came to him on the same day. He was installed on the throne by Indra himself and he then conquered the three worlds in righteous way, as once Vishnu did by three steps.

sa: शासतैनानधर्मज्ञान् मम विप्रियकारिणः। यदि प्रक्रीडते सर्वैर्देवैः सह शतक्रतुः॥
en: "Chastise these wicked witches who want to do what is not agreeable to me, even if he be Shatakratu (Indra) who is sporting here with all the celestials."

sa: एतस्मिन्नेव चार्थेऽसाविन्द्रगीता युधिष्ठिर। गाथा चरति लोकेऽस्मिन् गीयमाना द्विजातिभिः॥
en: O Yudhishthira, it is for this reason Indra sang the praises (of Sahadeva) in a verse which is still current in the world and sung by the Brahmanas.

sa: येनेष कुरुशार्दूल शार्दूल इव चेदिराट्। गर्जत्यतीव दुर्बुद्धिः सर्वानस्मानचिन्तयन्।॥
en: O best of the Kuru race, for this reason (only) this wicked-minded and tiger like Chedi king roars in this way without caring little for any of us.

sa: रुक्मिण्यामस्य मूढस्य प्रार्थनाऽऽसीन्मुमूर्षतः। न च तां प्राप्तवान् मूढः शूद्रो वेदश्रुतीमिव॥
en: Desirous as he was of a speedy death, this fool had (once) desired to possess Rukmani (Krishna's wife), but the fool did not obtain her, as a Shudra cannot get a hearing of the Vedas.

sa: स विजित्य ततो राजऋषिकान् रणमूर्धनि। शुकोदरसमांस्तत्र हयानष्टौ समानयत्॥
en: O king, having vanquished the Rishikas on the field of battle, he took from them as tribute eight horses that were of the colour of the parrot's breast.

sa: त्वं तुधर्ममतिर्नित्यंधर्मज्ञः सत्यसंगरः। विमुक्तः सर्वसङ्गेभ्यो भूय एव भविष्यसि॥
en: But your mind is always fixed on virtue; you are versed in the precepts of religion and you are truthful, you will surely be freed from all fears.

sa: परिक्रामति संसारे चक्रवद् बहुवेदनः। स वृत्तबन्धस्तु विशुद्धश्चापि कर्मभिः॥
en: Suffering from various miseries, they turn in this world like a wheel. If they cast off their bonds (of actions) and if they purify themselves by their actions,

sa: काश्मीरेष्वेव नागस्य भवनं तक्षकस्य च। वितस्ताख्यमिति ख्यातं सर्वपापप्रमोचनम्॥
en: The Tirtha known by the name of Vitasta is situated in Kashmira and it is the abode of Naga and Takshaka. It is capable of destroying all sins.

sa: मेरुमन्दरयोर्मध्ये शैलोदामभितो नदीम्। ये ते कीचकवेणूनां छायां रम्यामुपासते॥
en: Those, that live on the banks of the river Shailoda flowing between the mountains Meru and Mandara and enjoy the delicious shade of the groves of Kichaka bamboo,

sa: बाह्रीको रथमाहार्षीज्जाम्बूनदविभूषितम्। सुदक्षिणस्तु युयुजे श्वेतैः काम्बोजजैर्हयैः॥
en: Valhika himself brought there a car decked with gold. Sudakshina himself yoked to it four white horses of the Kamboja kind.

sa: सुदान्ता राजवहनाः सर्वशब्दक्षमा युधि। ईषादन्ता महाकायाः सर्वे चाष्टकरेणवः॥ सर्वे च पुरभेत्तारो नवमेघनिभा गजाः। एतद् राजन् मम धनं तेन दीव्याम्यहं त्वया॥
en: Who possess fine(white) tusks, tusks like plough-shafts, who are worthy of carrying kings and capable of withstanding every kind of noise on the field of battle, who have huge bodies, who are capable of battering down the walls of the hostile cities, who are of the colour of newly formed clouds and each of whom possesses eight female elephants. With this wealth, O king, I shall (now) stake with you.

sa: वसुमना अवतरेदित्यब्रवीदृषिः॥
en: The Rishi said, “Vasumana will fall first."

sa: लोके वैधर्म्यमेतत् तु दृश्यते बहुविस्तरम्। हीनज्ञानाश्च हृष्यन्ते क्लिश्यन्ते प्राज्ञकोविदाः॥ बहुदुःखपरिक्लेशं मानुष्यमिह दृश्यते।
en: Innumerable instances of such contradictory dispensations are seen in the world (by one who lives forever). The foolish and the ignorant are happy while the learned and the wise are miserable. Many instances of misery are seen among men in this world.

sa: तां स मृगयमाणो राजा नापश्यद् वापीमथ निःस्राव्य मण्डूकं श्वभ्रमुखे दृष्ट्वा क्रुद्ध आज्ञापयामास स राजा॥
en: When the king searched for her, he did not find any trace of her. He then ordered the water of the tank to be pumped out. He thereupon saw a frog sitting at the mouth of a hole. On seeing this, the king passed the following order in anger.

sa: पाण्डवाश्च महात्मानो दीना दुःखसमन्विताः। सत्येनातिपरीताङ्गा नोदीक्षन्ते स्म किंचन॥
en: Looking at their countenance, the king Duryodhana with cheerful heart thus addressed the Suta, “O Pratikamin, bring her here. Let the Kurus give their answer before her presence."

sa: ततः सूतस्तस्य वशानुगामी भीतश्च कोपाद् दुपदात्मजायाः. नुवाच कृष्णां किमहं ब्रवीमि॥
en: Duryodhana said O Dushasana, this foolish son of Suta is afraid of Vrikodara (Bhima). Go you yourself and forcibly bring Yajnaseni (Draupadi) here. Our enemies are now dependant on our will. What can they do?

sa: सम्यग् वेदमधीयाना यजन्ते विविधैर्मखैः। शान्तात्मानो जितक्रोधाः प्राप्नुवन्ति द्विजातयः॥ प्राप्तुं न शक्यो यो विद्वन् नरैर्दुष्कृतकर्मभिः। लोभाभिभूतैः कृपणेनार्यैरकृतात्मभिः॥ तं मां महाफलं विद्धि नराणां भावितात्मनाम्। सुदुष्प्रापं विमूढानां मार्ग योगैर्निषेवितम्॥
en: The Brahmanas, that have thoroughly studied the Vedas, that have obtained tranquility in their souls and that have subdued their anger, obtain a high reward by performing many sacrifices. But such reward is not obtained by men who are wicked in their acts, who are overwhelmed with covetousness, who are mean and disputable, who have their souls unblessed and impure. Therefore, O Brahmana, know that this reward which is obtained by only self-controlled men and not obtained by ignorant and foolish men-this which is attainable by asceticism alone, produces high merits.

sa: दुःखमेतादृशं प्राप्तो नल: परपुरंजयः। देवनेन नरश्रेष्ठ सभार्यो भरतर्षभ।॥
en: foremost of meu, O best of the Bharata race that conqueror of the hostile cities, Nala, thus fell into great distress in consequence of his playing at dice.

sa: युगान्ते समनुप्राप्ते वृथा च ब्रह्मवादिनः। भोवादिनस्तथा शूद्रा ब्राह्मणाश्चार्यवादिनः॥
en: When the end of the Yuga comes, the uttering of the Vedas become futile. The Shudras address (others) saying “Bho;" while the Brahinanas address (others) saying "Noble Sir."

sa: स्वप्रमाणमथो विप्र त्वया कृतमनेकशः। घोरेणाविश्य तपसा वेधसो निर्जितास्त्वया॥
en: O Brahmana, you have many times seen with your eyes, the primeval acts of creation. Being deeply engaged in severe asceticism, you have also excelled the celestials themselves.

sa: अक्षयूते समाह्वानं नियोगात् स्थविरस्य च। जानन्नपि क्षयकरं नातिक्रमितुमुत्सहे॥
en: This is a summons to dice, it is also the command of the old king. Though I know it will prove destructive to me, yet I cannot refuse.

sa: अहं लोकहितार्थं वै पिबामि वरुणालयम्। भवद्भिर्यदनुष्ठेयं तच्छीघ्रं संविधीयताम्॥
en: "For the good of the world, I shall drink up this abode of Varuna (ocean). You should at once make the preparations which devolves upon you to make."

sa: भीमसेन उवाच क्रूर पापजनैर्जुष्टमकृतार्थं प्रभाषसे। गान्धारविद्यया हि त्वं राजमध्ये विकत्थसे॥
en: Bhima said O crooked-minded wretch, you rave in words that are uttered only by the sinful. Being advanced by the skill of the Gandhara king, you (dare to) boast in the midst of these kings.

sa: तथेत्युक्त्वा तु सा देवी स्रवन्नेत्रजलाविला। शोणिताक्तैकवसना मुक्तकेशी विनिर्ययौ॥
en: Vaishampayana said Saying, "so be it,” the lady Draupadi clad in one cloth stained with blood, and with dishevelled hair, came out (of the inner apartment in tears.

sa: ऐहलौकिकमेवेह उताहो पारलौकिकम्। क्व च कर्माणि तिष्ठन्ति जन्तोः प्रेतस्य भार्गव॥
en: Do we reap the fruits of our acts in this life or in another existence? And O descendant of Bhrigu, where do the results of the acts of an animated creature rest after his death?”

sa: आनर्तमेवाभिमुखाः शिवेन गत्वाधनुर्वेदरतिप्रधानाः। तवात्मजा वृष्णिपुरं प्रविश्य न दैवतेभ्यः स्पृहयन्ति कृष्णे॥
en: And, O Krishna, safely proceeding towards the country of the Anartas when your sons, chiefly bent on the acquisition of arms, enter the city of the Vrishnis, they do not even long for celestials happiness.

sa: यत्कृतेऽहमिदं प्राप्ता तेषां वर्षे चतुर्दशे। हतपत्यो हतसुता हतबन्धुजनप्रियाः॥ बहुशोणितदिग्धाङ्गयो मुक्तकेशयो रजस्वलः। एवं कृतोदका भार्याः प्रवेक्ष्यन्ति गजाह्वयम्॥
en: “The wives of those for whom I have been reduced to such a plight shall, on the fourteenth year hence, deprived of their husbands, sons, relatives and dear ones smeared all over with blood, all in their seasons, and with hair dishevelled enter Hastinapur having offered oblations of water to the manes of their dead husbands.

sa: प्रभुः क्षमावान् वीरश्च दाता चाप्यधिको नृपः। रहोऽनीचानुवर्ती च क्लीबवन्मम नैषधः॥
en: My Naishadha is illustrious forgiving, warlike and liberal. He is supcrior to other monarchs; and he never behaves with low persons regarding private matters; and he is like an eunuch respecting other women than myself.

sa: अधीतमग्रे चरता व्रतानि सम्यग्धनुर्वेदमवाप्य कृत्स्नम्। क्षात्रेणधर्मेण वसूनि लब्ध्वा सर्वे ह्यवाप्ताः क्रतव; पुराणाः॥
en: You first studied (the Vedas) by observing the proper rites; you have next acquired mastery over the whole science of weapons; and then having obtained wealth by pursuing the methods followed by the Kshatriyas you have performed all the ancient sacrificial rites.

sa: धर्मः परः पाण्डव राज्यलाभात् तस्यार्थमाहुस्तप एव राजन्। सत्यार्जवाभ्यां चरता स्वधर्म जितस्त्वयायं च परश्च लोकः॥
en: "It is asserted (by the wise), O Pandava, that righteousness is superior to winning kingdoms and, O king, in order to foster it (virtue), asceticism is necessary. And you, who have performed your duties in strict obedience to truth and candour have conquered both this world and the next.

sa: बहुवत्सरजीवि च मार्कण्डेयो महातपाः। स्वाध्यायतपसा युक्तःक्षिप्रं युष्मान् समेष्यति॥
en: and Markandeya, who has lived for ages, has performed severe austerities, has studied the Vedas and who is given to devotion, will very soon come and join you.”

sa: दुर्योधनश्च कर्णश्च कटुकान्यभ्यभाषताम्॥ इति सर्वमिदं राजन्नाकुलं प्रतिभाति मे।
en: In the midst of the Kuru assembly, Duryodhana and Karna spoke cruel and harsh words to the distressed and enraged Krishna (Draupadi) who did not deserve such treatment.

sa: क्षुब्धतोया महावेगाः श्वसमाना इवाशुगाः। सिन्धवः शोभयांचक्रुः काननानि तपात्यये॥
en: At the close of summer, the streams full of agitated waters and careering violently with a hissing noise like (flight of) arrows, lent a grace to the woods.

sa: त्रिरात्रमुषितस्तत्र गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्। निदर्शनं च प्रत्यक्षं ब्राह्मणानां नराधिप॥
en: Living there for three nights, one obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine. O ruler of men, a strange phenomenon as regards Bralumanas is scen there.

sa: तथाहमपि जानामि नरनारायणावृषी। शक्तोऽयमित्यतो मत्वा मया स प्रेषितोऽर्जुनः॥ इन्द्रादनवरः शक्रं सुरसूनुः सुराधिपम्। द्रष्टुमस्त्राणि चादातुमिन्द्रादिति विवासितः॥ भीष्मद्रोणावतिरथौ कृपो द्रौणिश्च दुर्जयः। धृतराष्ट्रस्य पुत्रेण वृता युधि महारथाः॥
en: I also know them to be Rishis Nara and Narayana. Knowing him to be able, I have sent Arjuna away. He is not inferior to Indra and he is fully competent; I have sent him, that son of god (Arjuna) to see the king of the celestials and obtain weapons from him. Bhishma and Drona are mighty car-warriors; Kripa and the son of Drona are invincible. These great carwarriors have been installed by the son of Dhritarashtra (Duryodhana) in the command of his army.

sa: गुहाकारेण वक्त्रेण चतुर्दष्ट्रेण राजता। दीप्ताक्षणातिताप्रेण लिहानं सृक्किणी मुहुः॥
en: It had a mouth wide as a cave and furnished with four teeth; its eyes were copper-coloured and glaring and it constantly licked the corners of its mouth.

sa: तेषु सर्वेषु शान्तेषु गतेष्वविदितां गतिम्। निर्विवादा भविष्यन्तिधार्तराष्ट्रास्तथा वयम्॥
en: When they (the Pandavas) will be rooted out and when will go to the unknown journey, both ourselves and the sons of Dhritarashtra will be in (eternal) peace.

sa: मुक्तवान् दानवेन्द्राणां पराभावाय भारत। मुक्तमात्रे ततस्तस्मिन् रूपाण्यासन् सहस्रशः॥
en: O Bharata, I discharged (it) for the destruction of those foremost of the Danavas. No sooner had I hurled it, than it at once assumed a thousand shapes;

sa: अन्तर्भूमौ निपतति पुनरूज़ प्रतिष्ठते। पुनस्तिर्यक् प्रयात्याशु पुनरप्सु निमज्जति॥
en: At one time it plunged into the earth and then rose up in the air again, now it took a curved direction and then again submerged under water.

sa: रत्नदुममयश्चित्रैः सुस्वरैश्च पतत्रिभिः। पौलोमैः कालकजैश्च नित्यहृष्टैरधिष्ठितम्॥
en: Containing trees made of jewels, teeming with many-coloured birds of sweet voice, inhabited by the Paulomas and the Kalakanja ever merry,

sa: पर्वतैरुपचीयद्भिः पतमानैस्तथापरैः। स देशो यत्र वर्ताम गुहेव समपद्यत॥
en: On account of the rocks with which we were covered and of the others which were falling (around us), the place where we stationed, looked like a cave.

sa: न चामुद्रोऽभिनिर्याति न चामुद्रः प्रवेश्यते। वृष्ण्यन्धकपुरे राजस्तदा सौभसमागमे॥
en: O king, when Shalva thus came, none could, without presenting the sign, that was agreed upon, either enter or leave the city of the Vrishnis and the Andhakas.

sa: भर्तव्या रक्षणीया च पत्नी पत्या हि सर्वदा। तन्नष्टमुभयं कस्माद्धर्मज्ञस्य सतस्तव॥
en: Further do you cry, saying: "The wife is always to be maintained and protected by the husband. You are righteous and honest as well. Why, therefore, these virtues of yours are being neglected by you.

sa: दारुकेणाहमुत्पन्नो यथावच्चैव शिक्षितः। वीतभीः प्रविशाम्येतां शाल्वस्य प्रथितां चमूम्॥
en: I am born of Daruka and I have been duly trained (in my art); I shall now enter into the well-arranged army of Shalva without the least fear.

sa: सशाल्वं सौभनगरं हत्वा द्रष्टास्मि वः पुनः। त्रि: समाहन्यतामेषा दुन्दुभिः शत्रुभीषणा॥
en: I will again come back to you after destroying Shalva with his city “Saubha'' made of precious metals. Strike up the three notes of the Dundubhi (musical instrument) which are so dreadful to the foes."

sa: ततो व्योम महाराज शतसूर्यमिवाभवत्। शतचन्द्रं च कौन्तेय सहस्रायुततारकम्॥
en: O great king, O son of Kunti, then the sky blazed forth with one hundred suns, with one hundred moons and thousands and tens of thousands of stars.

sa: ते मातलेश्चक्रुरतीव हृष्टाः सत्कारमवयं सुरराजतुल्यम्। सर्वान् यथावच्च दिवौकसस्ते पप्रच्छुरेनं कुरुराजपुत्राः॥
en: Those descendants of the king Kuru, being exceedingly delighted, paid excellent adoration to Matali, worthy of the lord of the celestials himself; and then duly inquired of him about the welfare of all the gods,

sa: अन्यच्च तस्याद्भुतदर्शनीयं विकूजितं पादयोः सम्प्रभाति। पाण्योश्च तद्वत् स्वनवन्निबद्धौ कलापकावक्षमाला यथेयम्॥
en: There was on his feet something of a wonderful shape which gave forth a jingling sound. There were also ornaments tied upon his wrists that made a similar sound; they looked like this rosary here.

sa: समवायः स राजेन्द्र सुमहाद्भुतदर्शनः। आसीन्महात्मनां तेषां काम्यके भरतर्षभ॥
en: O king of kings, O best of the Bharata race, the crowd of people that surrounded those high-souled men the (Pandavas) in the forest of Kamyaka was extraordinary.

sa: धनुष्कोटिमवष्टभ्य वक्रभावेन बाहुना। पश्यमानः स खेदेन द्रविणाधिपतेः पुरम्॥
en: Leaning against the end of his bow with banded arm, he stood beholding the city of Kubera with great sorrow caused by the remembrance of his own fortune).

sa: पुण्याहवाचने राज्ञः सुनन्दासहितां स्थिताम्। मन्दं प्रख्यायमानेन रूपेणाप्रतिमेन ताम्॥ निबद्धां धूमजालेन प्रभामिव विभावसोः। तां समीक्ष्य विशालाक्षीमधिकं मलिनां कृशाम्। तर्कयामास भैमीति कारणैरुपपादयन्॥
en: She seated with Sunanda, in the house of that monarch, who at the time was repeating his prayers. She was faintly seen, on account of the great luminosity of her extraordinary beauty. Even as her splendour was like the blazing of a fire enveloped by smokes. Thus beholding that lady, with large eyes, colorless and weak, he, after arguing from various reasons, decided her to be the daughter of Bhima.

sa: रुवाच सूर्याग्निसमप्रभावः। जाते च पुत्रे वनमेवाव्रजेथा राज्ञः प्रियाण्यस्य सर्वाणि कृत्वा॥
en: Keeping his son there, that great Rishi, as effulgent as the sun or the fire, said "Having done all that would please the king and having begotten a son, you must come to the forest."

sa: शिखरस्थं समासीनमधिपं यक्षरक्षसाम्। प्रेक्षन्ते सर्वभूतानि भानुमन्तमिवोदितम्॥
en: All the creatures then behold the King of the Rakshasas seated on the summit and looking like the sun just risen

sa: कमलोत्पलकह्लारपुण्डरीकसुगन्धिना। सेव्यमाना वने तस्मिन् सुखस्पर्शेन वायुना॥
en: And as they walked on they were fanned by the breeze of balmy feel perfumed by Kamalas, Utapalas, Kalparas and Pandarikas.

sa: शकुनिस्तन्तुबद्धो वा नियतोऽयमनीश्वरः। ईश्वरस्य वशे तिष्ठेन्नान्येषां नात्मनः प्रभुः॥
en: Like a bird tied with a string all creatures depend upon God; they all live in dependence upon God not upon others; nor are they their own masters.

sa: अन्यथा परिदृष्टानि मुनिभिस्तत्त्वदर्शिभिः। अन्यथा परिवर्तन्ते वेगा इव नभस्वतः॥
en: This is seen in a different light by the sages seeing the real truths; they appear to them in a different light like the rays of the sun.

sa: नानाद्रुमनिरोधेषु वसन्तः शैलसानुषु। पर्वतं विविशुः श्वेतं चतुर्थेऽहनि पाण्डवाः॥
en: And at times having dwelt on the level grounds above the mountains thickly overgrown with many trees, the Pandavas on the fourth day got to the mountain Shveta.

sa: नाहं कर्मफलान्वेषी राजपुत्रि चराम्युत। ददामि देयमित्येव यजै यष्टव्यमित्युत॥
en: O princess, I never act being desirous of the fruits thereof; I distribute (a thing) which should be distributed and I perform a sacrifice which should be performed.

sa: जङ्गमेषु विशेषेण मनुष्या भरतर्षभ। इच्छन्ति कर्मणा वृत्तिमवाप्तुं प्रेत्य चेह च॥
en: O foremost of Bharatas, this is the difference of man from mobile creatures, that he aspires to like his course of life both in this world and in the next by means of his acts.

sa: विशाला बदरी दृष्टा नरनारायणाश्रमः। दिव्या पुष्करिणी दृष्टा सिद्धदेवर्षिपूजिता॥
en: And also the great Badari, where there is the herinitage of Nara and Narayana. We have seen the celestials lake adored by the Siddhas and he celestials Rishis.

sa: स मां राजन् कर्मवतीमागतामाह सान्त्वयन्। शुश्रूषमाणामासीनां पितुरङ्के युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O king, O Yudhishthira, he said this to me, consoling, who had approached my father for some work and who for serving was seated on my father's lap.

sa: तस्या मामनवद्याझ्याधर्मपल्याः प्रिये स्थितम्। पुष्पाहारमिह प्राप्तं निबोधत निशाचराः॥
